name: Laura Quest
source:
Laura Quest is a Tropical Rouge Pretty Cure fangame and a visual novel exploring the hypothetical scenario posed by the series' ending: "What if everyone lost their memories of each other?"

Play as the soon to be queen, Laura Apollodoros Hyginus La Mer, as she navigates the human world in search of the only people she really considers friends.

[Edited from [url=https://intergoatlactic.itch.io/laura-quest]itch.io[/url]]
